lessons.title: Asking a question with if / else

exercise.prompt: Finish the program: it asks for an age, then prints `Adult` for 18 and over, and `Minor` otherwise.

files.age.py:
age = int(input("How old are you? "))
# Print Adult for 18 and over, otherwise Minor

hints: `if age >= 18:` runs the indented lines under it only when the condition is true.
`else:` catches every other case. Both lines under them need the same indentation.
